The '''Kolatill Defense Force''' was the primary military organization of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kolatill]] in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The unit was formed in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] after the planet's population overthrew the local [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]], [[Tetrum]], and declared its allegiance to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] following the successful [[Battle of Kal'Shebbol|liberation]] of the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]] from the [[Moff Sarne's forces|forces]] of [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]]. Consisting of six [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]], the Defense Force was charged with the protection of the world.

Several days after the unit was created, it joined forces with the New Republic [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'' and its [[FarStar starfighter squadron|starfighter squadron]] to defend the planet from an [[Battle of Kolatill|attack]] by the [[Ton-Falk-class escort carrier|''Ton-Falk''-class escort carrier]] ''[[Kathol Protector]]''. The ''FarStar'' was assisting in relief operations following an [[Bombing of Domaz|earlier assault]] on the planet's capital, [[Domaz]], by the ''Kathol Protector''. During the battle, the combined Kolatill&ndash;New Republic force managed to destroy the assault force of [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]] that were intent on dropping [[pathogenic bomb]]s on the planet's [[City/Legends|cities]].

==History==
In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Battle of Kal'Shebbol|liberated]] [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], forcing [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]] to abandon the majority of his [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] holdings and flee into the depths of the [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. In response, the neighboring [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kolatill]] ousted its [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]], [[Tetrum]]; declared allegiance to the New Republic; and returned control of the planet to its local government, the [[Kolatill Council]]. Once in control, the Council established the Kolatill Defense Force to assist in protecting the world, although the small force was only equipped with six [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE starfighters]].<ref name="O" />

In retaliation for the planet's defiance, Moff Sarne detailed the [[Ton-Falk-class escort carrier|''Ton-Falk''-class escort carrier]] ''[[Kathol Protector]]'' to assault the world. [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE bombers]] launched from the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] [[Bombing of Domaz|devastated]] the capital [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Domaz]]. The Kolatill Council issued a [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signal]] following the attack, which was answered by the New Republic [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]''. As the ship arrived in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of Kolatill four days later, the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] of the Kolatill Defense Force challenged them, requesting identification. Once made aware that the vessel represented the New Republic, the fighters provided escort for relief [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] descending to the surface to provide aid to Domaz.<ref name="O" />

Shortly after the arrival of the ''FarStar'', the ''Kathol Protector'' returned to conduct a [[Battle of Kolatill|second attack]] on Kolatill. This time, the Imperial force intended to use [[pathogenic bomb]]s and target several cities on the surface to maximize casualties and damage. While the ''FarStar'' and part of its [[FarStar starfighter squadron|starfighter squadron]] engaged TIE starfighters in [[Realspace/Legends|space]], the Kolatill Defense Force joined a small contingent of fighters from the corvette that had been on the surface at the time of the attack in fending off waves of TIE bombers. The combined Kolatill&ndash;New Republic force managed to destroy the attacking Imperial force without allowing them to drop their deadly cargo.<ref name="O" />

==Organization==
The Kolatill Defense Force consisted of six standard model TIE starfighters and their [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]].<ref name="O" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kolatill Defense Force was introduced in the [[Roleplaying game|RPG]] adventure ''[[Omens]]'', which was published as part of ''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]'' by [[West End Games]] in [[1995]].<ref name="O" />
